recipe.visualDefinition: A central square portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat set against a larger, textured background featuring distressed edges, ink splatters, and fingerprint patterns in earthy, muted tones.
coreVisualRelationships: Central square frame inset within a larger textured border
High-contrast portrait lighting against a dark, moody background
Textured, tactile background elements contrasting with the smooth photographic subject
Symmetrical typographic placement framing the central image
coreInvariants: Black cowboy hat as a primary silhouette
Distressed, 'dirty' paper texture for the outer frame
Subtle fingerprint and ink-blot motifs in the corners
Drop shadow beneath the central square to create depth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a medium close-up portrait centered within a square frame that occupies approximately 60% of the total canvas height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's eyes and the sharp brim of the black cowboy hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, move down to the portrait, and settle on the bottom caption text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample textured negative space around the central square, providing a 'scrapbook' or 'archival' feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark shadows within the portrait.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm tan and beige tones for the textured background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted orange or copper for the bottom text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the black clothing/hat and the light tan background.

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a condensed, high-waisted serif for the first line and a wider, slightly irregular sans-serif for the second.
Bottom text uses a lowercase, wide-tracked sans-serif.
Horizontal bars flank the top line of text.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' and 'G' in the main name have a slightly hand-drawn, organic circularity.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrasting a condensed, formal serif with a wide, casual lowercase sans-serif.

preserve: Wide tracking on the bottom text
Condensed nature of the top name
Horizontal bars flanking the top text
avoid: Clean, sharp edges on the background

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the sturdy, slightly flared feel of the secondary name line.
For the distressed, organic feel of the background elements.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a textured tan background with heavy grunge distressing on the left and right edges. Include faint fingerprint patterns in the corners and dark ink splatters. Place a central square photographic portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat with a moody, low-key lighting style. Add a subtle drop shadow to the square frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name at the top center using a condensed serif font, flanked by two thin horizontal lines. Add the secondary title at the bottom center of the square frame in a wide-tracked, lowercase humanist sans-serif in a muted copper color.

verificationChecks: Is the central image a square?
Are the edges of the outer frame distressed and 'dirty'?
Is the bottom text lowercase and widely spaced?

adjustableVariables: Color of the bottom text (copper vs. gold)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the artist name and album title
Specific placement of individual ink splatters
postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the horizontal bars flanking the top text.
Ensure the central square has a visible drop shadow.
Verify the background texture looks like aged, stained paper.
Confirm the bottom text is lowercase with wide tracking.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central square portrait + distressed paper frame + fingerprint/ink motifs + condensed serif top text + wide-tracked lowercase sans-serif bottom text.
